title: Outbox / inbox with engine state (VI.2)
database: PostgreSQL 17 (Testcontainers postgres:17-alpine), one database per engine

scenarios.name: Event appended in the same transaction as a task completion; the relay publishes it to every destination
Relay crash between publish and mark: re-published after the claim lease, the consumer dedups on event_id, every destination ends DONE
Rollback of the engine command also removes the outbox row (exception after the callback, and an engine failure inside the command)

measurements.engineFailure: FlowableException: Unknown property used in expression: ${checkerDecision == 'forward'} with Execution[ id '77' ] - definition 'wf1-bill:1:4' - activity 'wf1_checkerDecisionGw' - parent '69' - tenantId 'tn-e5'

scenarios.name: A late commit with a lower outbox id is still delivered (state scan, no id watermark)
Early inbound message (WF-3 clarification) is buffered, then correlated when the instance reaches the catch event; a redelivery is dropped
